# Common setup ---------------------------------------------------------------
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table); library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(ggplot2)

})

b73_full_path <- "/projects/standard/hirschc1/menar060/family_analysis/redo_full_sequence/B73/output/B73_full_sequence_silix.out"
b73_5prime_path <- "/projects/standard/hirschc1/menar060/family_analysis/redo_five_prime/B73/output/B73_five_prime_silix.out"
setaria_full_path <- "/projects/standard/hirschc1/menar060/family_analysis/redo_full_sequence/Setaria/output/Milhouse_plus_full_sequence_silix.out"
setaria_5prime_path <- "/projects/standard/hirschc1/menar060/family_analysis/redo_five_prime/Setaria/output/Milhouse_plus_five_prime_silix.out"

output_dir <- "final_panel_figures"
dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings=FALSE, recursive=TRUE)

divergent_palette <- c("#27408B","#1B9E77","#2AA198","#56B4E9",
                       "#E6AB02","#D55E6A","#984EA3","#7F1D3A")
status_colors <- c("Clustering concordance"=divergent_palette[1],
                   "Clustering discordance"=divergent_palette[8])
discordance_type_colors <- c(
  "Concordant"=divergent_palette[1],
  "Merge-associated"=divergent_palette[5],
  "Split-and-merge"=divergent_palette[8],
  "Split-associated"=divergent_palette[7]
)

publication_theme <- theme_classic(base_size=10) +
  theme(axis.title=element_text(face="bold"),
        strip.text=element_text(face="bold"),
        legend.title=element_text(face="bold"))

extract_silix_attribute <- function(x, attribute_name) {
  pattern <- paste0("(?:^|;)", attribute_name, "=([^;]+)")
  out <- sub(paste0(".*", pattern, ".*"), "\\1", as.character(x), perl=TRUE)
  out[!grepl(pattern, as.character(x), perl=TRUE)] <- NA_character_
  out
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Species-specific structural-TE matching
#
# IMPORTANT:
#   Maize and Setaria both have lLTR_ added to 5′ LTR IDs, but Setaria full
#   structural IDs are heterogeneous. Therefore the same literal replacement
#   cannot be used for both species.
#
#   Maize:
#     lLTR_51885 -> LTRRT_51885
#
#   Setaria:
#     lLTR_RLCS... -> RLCS...
#     lLTR_RLGS... -> RLGS...
#     lLTR_RLXS... -> LTRRT_RLXS... when that is the full-sequence ID
#
#   For Setaria, both candidate parent IDs are tested against the IDs actually
#   present in the full-sequence SiLiX file. This is the recovery strategy that
#   retains the complete structural-LTR set rather than the erroneous ~72 TEs.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

read_assignments <- function(full_path, five_path, species) {

  f <- fread(
    full_path, header=FALSE, sep="\t", select=1:2,
    col.names=c("Family_ID","Element_ID")
  )
  l <- fread(
    five_path, header=FALSE, sep="\t", select=1:2,
    col.names=c("Family_ID","Element_ID")
  )

  ff <- f %>%
    mutate(
      TE_ID = extract_silix_attribute(Element_ID, "ID"),
      Full_Seq_Family = paste0(species, "_Full_", Family_ID)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(TE_ID)) %>%
    distinct(TE_ID, .keep_all=TRUE) %>%
    select(TE_ID, Full_Seq_Family)

  five_raw <- l %>%
    mutate(
      Five_Prime_LTR_ID = extract_silix_attribute(Element_ID, "ID"),
      Five_Prime_Family = paste0(species, "_5prime_", Family_ID)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Five_Prime_LTR_ID))

  if (species == "B73") {

    ll <- five_raw %>%
      mutate(
        TE_ID = sub("^lLTR_", "LTRRT_", Five_Prime_LTR_ID)
      )

  } else if (species == "Setaria") {

    full_setaria_ids <- unique(ff$TE_ID)

    ll <- five_raw %>%
      mutate(
        Candidate_TE_ID_1 = sub("^lLTR_", "", Five_Prime_LTR_ID),
        Candidate_TE_ID_2 = paste0("LTRRT_", Candidate_TE_ID_1),

        Candidate_1_Matches = Candidate_TE_ID_1 %in% full_setaria_ids,
        Candidate_2_Matches = Candidate_TE_ID_2 %in% full_setaria_ids,

        TE_ID = case_when(
          Candidate_1_Matches ~ Candidate_TE_ID_1,
          Candidate_2_Matches ~ Candidate_TE_ID_2,
          TRUE ~ NA_character_
        )
      )

  } else {
    stop("Unknown species: ", species)
  }

  ll <- ll %>%
    filter(!is.na(TE_ID)) %>%
    distinct(TE_ID, .keep_all=TRUE) %>%
    select(TE_ID, Five_Prime_Family)

  joined <- inner_join(ff, ll, by="TE_ID") %>%
    mutate(Species=species)

  cat(
    "\n================ ", species, " ID CHECK ================\n",
    "Full-sequence unique structural TEs: ", scales::comma(n_distinct(ff$TE_ID)), "\n",
    "Recovered 5′ LTR structural TEs:     ", scales::comma(n_distinct(ll$TE_ID)), "\n",
    "Shared TEs used in Figure 1:         ", scales::comma(n_distinct(joined$TE_ID)), "\n",
    sep=""
  )

  # Hard guards: do not silently make a figure from a catastrophically
  # incomplete join.
  if (species == "B73" && n_distinct(joined$TE_ID) < 50000) {
    stop(
      "Maize structural-TE recovery failed: fewer than 50,000 shared TEs. ",
      "Do not use the figure."
    )
  }

  if (species == "Setaria" && n_distinct(joined$TE_ID) < 500) {
    stop(
      "Setaria structural-TE recovery failed: fewer than 500 shared TEs. ",
      "Do not use the figure."
    )
  }

  joined
}

classify <- function(x) {
  # Pair counts
  pairs <- x %>%
    count(Species, Full_Seq_Family, Five_Prime_Family, name="pair_size")

  # Unique largest overlap in the full-sequence direction
  pairs <- pairs %>%
    group_by(Species, Full_Seq_Family) %>%
    mutate(
      full_family_size = sum(pair_size),
      full_partner_count = n_distinct(Five_Prime_Family),
      Largest_Pair_in_Full = max(pair_size),
      Number_Tied_for_Full_Max = sum(pair_size == Largest_Pair_in_Full),
      Unique_Full_Maximum =
        pair_size == Largest_Pair_in_Full &
        Number_Tied_for_Full_Max == 1
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  # Unique largest overlap in the 5′ LTR direction
  pairs <- pairs %>%
    group_by(Species, Five_Prime_Family) %>%
    mutate(
      five_prime_family_size = sum(pair_size),
      five_partner_count = n_distinct(Full_Seq_Family),
      Largest_Pair_in_Five = max(pair_size),
      Number_Tied_for_Five_Max = sum(pair_size == Largest_Pair_in_Five),
      Unique_Five_Maximum =
        pair_size == Largest_Pair_in_Five &
        Number_Tied_for_Five_Max == 1
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      # TE-level status used in Panel C
      Mutual_Unique_Largest =
        Unique_Full_Maximum & Unique_Five_Maximum,
      Pair_Status = if_else(
        Mutual_Unique_Largest,
        "Clustering concordance",
        "Clustering discordance"
      ),

      # Exact 1:1 relationship used for family-level status
      Exact_One_to_One_Match =
        full_partner_count == 1 &
        five_partner_count == 1 &
        pair_size == full_family_size &
        pair_size == five_prime_family_size,

      Discordance_Type = case_when(
        Exact_One_to_One_Match ~ "Concordant",
        full_partner_count > 1 & five_partner_count == 1 ~ "Split-associated",
        full_partner_count == 1 & five_partner_count > 1 ~ "Merge-associated",
        full_partner_count > 1 & five_partner_count > 1 ~ "Split-and-merge",
        TRUE ~ "Split-and-merge"
      )
    )

  # Join the TE-level classification back to every TE
  el <- x %>%
    left_join(
      pairs %>%
        select(
          Species, Full_Seq_Family, Five_Prime_Family,
          pair_size, full_family_size, five_prime_family_size,
          full_partner_count, five_partner_count,
          Mutual_Unique_Largest, Pair_Status,
          Exact_One_to_One_Match, Discordance_Type
        ),
      by=c("Species","Full_Seq_Family","Five_Prime_Family")
    )

  # Family-level classification used in Panel B.
  # Each family is counted once under each clustering definition.
  fullfam <- pairs %>%
    group_by(Species, Full_Seq_Family) %>%
    summarise(
      Method="Full sequence",
      Family=first(Full_Seq_Family),
      family_size=first(full_family_size),
      Status=if_else(
        n_distinct(Five_Prime_Family) == 1 &
        all(Exact_One_to_One_Match),
        "Clustering concordance",
        "Clustering discordance"
      ),
      .groups="drop"
    )

  fivefam <- pairs %>%
    group_by(Species, Five_Prime_Family) %>%
    summarise(
      Method="5′ LTR",
      Family=first(Five_Prime_Family),
      family_size=first(five_prime_family_size),
      Status=if_else(
        n_distinct(Full_Seq_Family) == 1 &
        all(Exact_One_to_One_Match),
        "Clustering concordance",
        "Clustering discordance"
      ),
      .groups="drop"
    )

  list(
    elements=el,
    pairs=pairs,
    families=bind_rows(fullfam,fivefam)
  )
}

b73 <- classify(read_assignments(b73_full_path,b73_5prime_path,"B73"))
setaria <- classify(read_assignments(setaria_full_path,setaria_5prime_path,"Setaria"))
combined_elements <- bind_rows(b73$elements,setaria$elements)
combined_pairs <- bind_rows(b73$pairs,setaria$pairs)
combined_families <- bind_rows(b73$families,setaria$families)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(ggalluvial); library(cowplot)})

# A. Number of families -------------------------------------------------------
family_counts <- combined_families %>%
  count(Species,Method,name="Number_of_Families") %>%
  mutate(
    Species=factor(Species,c("B73","Setaria")),
    Method=factor(Method,c("Full sequence","5′ LTR"))
  )

method_colors <- c(
  "Full sequence"=divergent_palette[4],
  "5′ LTR"=divergent_palette[7]
)

# IMPORTANT: free y scales are intentional here.
# Maize and Setaria have very different absolute family counts, and the
# separate axes make the similar proportional decrease visible.
pA <- ggplot(
  family_counts,
  aes(Method,Number_of_Families,fill=Method)
) +
  geom_col(width=.68,color="black",linewidth=.45) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label=comma(Number_of_Families)),
    vjust=-.35,size=3
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~Species,
    scales="free_y",
    axes="all_y",
    labeller=as_labeller(c(B73="Maize",Setaria="Setaria"))
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=method_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels=comma,
    breaks=scales::pretty_breaks(n=5),
    expand=expansion(mult=c(0,.16))
  ) +
  labs(x=NULL,y="Number of TE families") +
  publication_theme +
  theme(
    legend.position="none",
    panel.spacing.x=unit(.45,"cm"),
    axis.title.y=element_text(margin=margin(r=7)),
    axis.text.x=element_text(size=7.5)
  )

# B. FAMILY-level concordance --------------------------------------------------
# This matches Slide 1 Panel B: each family is counted once under its
# clustering definition, and the two methods are pooled within species.
family_prop <- combined_families %>%
  count(Species,Status,name="n") %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  mutate(
    total_n=sum(n),
    prop=n/total_n,
    inside_label=paste0(comma(n),"\n",percent(prop,accuracy=.1))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Status=factor(
    Status,
    c("Clustering concordance","Clustering discordance")
  ))

family_totals <- family_prop %>%
  distinct(Species,total_n) %>%
  mutate(n_label=paste0("n = ",comma(total_n)," families"))

pB <- ggplot(family_prop,aes(Species,prop,fill=Status)) +
  geom_col(width=.62,color="black",linewidth=.45) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label=inside_label),
    position=position_stack(vjust=.5),
    color="white",fontface="bold",size=3
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data=family_totals,
    aes(x=Species,y=1.055,label=n_label),
    inherit.aes=FALSE,
    size=2.8
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=status_colors,name=NULL) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels=c(B73="Maize",Setaria="Setaria")) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels=label_percent(),
    breaks=seq(0,1,.25),
    limits=c(0,1.10),
    expand=c(0,0)
  ) +
  labs(x=NULL,y="Proportion of TE families") +
  publication_theme +
  theme(
    legend.position="top",
    legend.text=element_text(size=7),
    legend.key.size=unit(.32,"cm"),
    legend.spacing.x=unit(.15,"cm")
  ) +
  guides(fill=guide_legend(nrow=1,byrow=TRUE))

# C. INDIVIDUAL-TE concordance -------------------------------------------------
# IMPORTANT: classification logic is unchanged from the supplied Figure 1
# script. Only structural-TE ID recovery was corrected above.
# TE-level concordance uses the mutually-unique-largest-overlap definition.
te_prop <- combined_elements %>%
  distinct(Species,TE_ID,.keep_all=TRUE) %>%
  count(Species,Pair_Status,name="n") %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  mutate(
    total_n=sum(n),
    prop=n/total_n,
    inside_label=paste0(comma(n),"\n",percent(prop,accuracy=.1))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Pair_Status=factor(
    Pair_Status,
    c("Clustering concordance","Clustering discordance")
  ))

te_totals <- te_prop %>%
  distinct(Species,total_n) %>%
  mutate(n_label=paste0("n = ",comma(total_n)," TEs"))

pC <- ggplot(te_prop,aes(Species,prop,fill=Pair_Status)) +
  geom_col(width=.62,color="black",linewidth=.45) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label=inside_label),
    position=position_stack(vjust=.5),
    color="white",fontface="bold",size=3
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data=te_totals,
    aes(x=Species,y=1.055,label=n_label),
    inherit.aes=FALSE,
    size=2.8
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=status_colors,name=NULL) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels=c(B73="Maize",Setaria="Setaria")) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels=label_percent(),
    breaks=seq(0,1,.25),
    limits=c(0,1.10),
    expand=c(0,0)
  ) +
  labs(x=NULL,y="Proportion of individual TEs") +
  publication_theme +
  theme(legend.position="none")

# D. Direction-neutral topology by Small / Medium / Large ---------------------
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(igraph))

topology_edges <- combined_pairs %>%
  transmute(
    Species,Full_Seq_Family,Five_Prime_Family,pair_size,
    Full_Node=paste0(Species,"::FULL::",Full_Seq_Family),
    Five_Node=paste0(Species,"::FIVE::",Five_Prime_Family)
  )

family_graph <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(
  topology_edges %>% select(Full_Node,Five_Node),
  directed=FALSE
)

graph_components <- igraph::components(family_graph)

node_component_lookup <- tibble::tibble(
  Node=names(graph_components$membership),
  Component_ID=as.integer(graph_components$membership)
)

topology_edges <- topology_edges %>%
  left_join(
    node_component_lookup %>% rename(Full_Node=Node),
    by="Full_Node"
  )

if(any(is.na(topology_edges$Component_ID))) {
  stop("Some family pairs could not be assigned to a connected component.")
}

component_topology <- topology_edges %>%
  group_by(Species,Component_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    Number_of_TEs=sum(pair_size),
    Number_of_Full_Families=n_distinct(Full_Seq_Family),
    Number_of_Five_Prime_Families=n_distinct(Five_Prime_Family),
    .groups="drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Topology=case_when(
      Number_of_Full_Families==1 & Number_of_Five_Prime_Families==1 ~
        "Concordant",
      Number_of_Full_Families==1 & Number_of_Five_Prime_Families>1 ~
        "Split-associated",
      Number_of_Full_Families>1 & Number_of_Five_Prime_Families==1 ~
        "Merge-associated",
      Number_of_Full_Families>1 & Number_of_Five_Prime_Families>1 ~
        "Split-and-merge",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Size_Category=case_when(
      Number_of_TEs<=10 ~ "Small",
      Number_of_TEs<=100 ~ "Medium",
      Number_of_TEs>100 ~ "Large",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Species=factor(Species,c("B73","Setaria")),
    Size_Category=factor(
      Size_Category,
      c("Small","Medium","Large"),
      labels=c("Small\n(≤10 TEs)","Medium\n(11–100 TEs)","Large\n(>100 TEs)")
    ),
    Topology=factor(
      Topology,
      c("Concordant","Merge-associated","Split-and-merge","Split-associated")
    )
  )

topology_by_size_df <- component_topology %>%
  count(
    Species,Size_Category,Topology,
    name="Number_of_Relationships",
    .drop=FALSE
  ) %>%
  group_by(Species,Size_Category) %>%
  mutate(
    Total_Relationships=sum(Number_of_Relationships),
    Proportion=if_else(
      Total_Relationships>0,
      Number_of_Relationships/Total_Relationships,
      NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(Total_Relationships>0)

relationship_size_labels <- topology_by_size_df %>%
  distinct(Species,Size_Category,Total_Relationships) %>%
  mutate(Label=paste0("n = ",comma(Total_Relationships)))

topology_colors_direction_neutral <- c(
  "Concordant"=divergent_palette[1],
  "Split-associated"=divergent_palette[3],
  "Merge-associated"=divergent_palette[5],
  "Split-and-merge"=divergent_palette[8]
)

pD <- ggplot(
  topology_by_size_df,
  aes(Size_Category,Proportion,fill=Topology)
) +
  geom_col(width=.65,color="black",linewidth=.4) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label=if_else(
      !is.na(Proportion) & Proportion>=.04,
      percent(Proportion,accuracy=.1),
      ""
    )),
    position=position_stack(vjust=.5),
    color="white",
    fontface="bold",
    size=2.55
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data=relationship_size_labels,
    aes(Size_Category,1.045,label=Label),
    inherit.aes=FALSE,
    size=2.35
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~Species,
    nrow=1,
    labeller=as_labeller(c(B73="Maize",Setaria="Setaria"))
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values=topology_colors_direction_neutral,
    breaks=c(
      "Concordant",
      "Merge-associated",
      "Split-and-merge",
      "Split-associated"
    ),
    drop=FALSE,
    name=NULL
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits=c(0,1.10),
    breaks=seq(0,1,.25),
    labels=label_percent(),
    expand=c(0,0)
  ) +
  labs(
    x="Relationship size",
    y="Proportion of family relationships"
  ) +
  publication_theme +
  theme(
    # Two-row legend prevents it from running off the right edge.
    legend.position="top",
    legend.justification="left",
    legend.box.just="left",
    legend.text=element_text(size=5.7),
    legend.key.size=unit(.27,"cm"),
    legend.spacing.x=unit(.10,"cm"),
    panel.spacing.x=unit(.30,"cm"),
    axis.text.x=element_text(
      size=6.2,
      lineheight=.88,
      margin=margin(t=4)
    ),
    axis.title.x=element_text(
      size=8.5,
      face="bold",
      margin=margin(t=9)
    ),
    axis.title.y=element_text(
      size=8.5,
      face="bold",
      margin=margin(r=6)
    ),
    strip.text=element_text(size=8.5,face="bold"),
    plot.margin=margin(3,4,8,4)
  ) +
  guides(
    fill=guide_legend(
      nrow=2,
      byrow=TRUE,
      title.position="top"
    )
  )

# E/F. Top-10 full-sequence-family alluvials ----------------------------------
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ggalluvial))
top_n <- 10

make_top_alluvial <- function(results_object,species_label) {

  top_full_ids <- results_object$families %>%
    filter(Method=="Full sequence") %>%
    arrange(desc(family_size)) %>%
    slice_head(n=top_n) %>%
    pull(Family)

  alluvial_top_df <- results_object$pairs %>%
    filter(Full_Seq_Family %in% top_full_ids) %>%
    mutate(
      Discordance_Type=factor(
        Discordance_Type,
        levels=c(
          "Concordant",
          "Merge-associated",
          "Split-and-merge",
          "Split-associated"
        )
      )
    )

  if(nrow(alluvial_top_df)==0) {
    stop(paste("No alluvial data found for",species_label))
  }

  ggplot(
    alluvial_top_df,
    aes(
      axis1=Full_Seq_Family,
      axis2=Five_Prime_Family,
      y=pair_size
    )
  ) +
    ggalluvial::geom_alluvium(
      aes(fill=Discordance_Type),
      width=.22,
      alpha=.85,
      color="white",
      linewidth=.2
    ) +
    ggalluvial::geom_stratum(
      width=.22,
      fill="white",
      color="black",
      linewidth=.5
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values=topology_colors_direction_neutral,
      breaks=c(
        "Concordant",
        "Merge-associated",
        "Split-and-merge",
        "Split-associated"
      ),
      drop=FALSE,
      name="Classification relationship"
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(
      limits=c("Full-sequence families","5′ LTR families"),
      expand=c(.08,.08)
    ) +
    labs(
      title=species_label,
      x=NULL,
      y="Number of TEs"
    ) +
    publication_theme +
    theme(
      axis.line.x=element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x=element_blank(),
      legend.position="none",
      plot.title=element_text(
        hjust=.5,
        face="bold",
        size=10,
        margin=margin(b=6)
      ),
      axis.text.x=element_text(
        size=7,
        margin=margin(t=7)
      ),
      axis.text.y=element_text(size=7),
      axis.title.y=element_text(
        size=8.5,
        face="bold",
        margin=margin(r=6)
      ),
      plot.margin=margin(4,8,12,8)
    )
}

pE <- make_top_alluvial(b73,"Maize")
pF <- make_top_alluvial(setaria,"Setaria")

# Final six-panel figure -------------------------------------------------------
figure1 <- (
  (pA | pB) /
  (pC | pD) /
  (pE | pF)
) +
  plot_layout(
    heights=c(.92,1.12,1.40)
  ) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels="A") &
  theme(
    plot.tag=element_text(face="bold",size=12),
    plot.tag.position=c(.01,.99),
    plot.margin=margin(4,6,6,6)
  )

# Slightly wider output gives Panel D and the alluvial x labels enough room.
ggsave(
  file.path(output_dir,"Figure1_full_panel_FIXED_SPECIES_IDS.jpeg"),
  figure1,
  width=8.5,
  height=9.4,
  units="in",
  dpi=600,
  bg="white"
)

ggsave(
  file.path(output_dir,"Figure1_full_panel_FIXED_SPECIES_IDS.pdf"),
